_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (CLAUDE.md, 'Code organization: 500-line file convention'), as of 2026-08-12. No files currently over the limit — this baseline is empty on purpose, so checkFileLength.mjs fails on ANY file crossing 500 lines from here on, not just regressions. Add an entry (with a one-line reason) only for a genuinely justified exception, not to silence a violation.
